answer: An agent earns voting weight only when an unaffiliated sponsor locks a bond behind it, and each sponsor may back only a few agents. Honest sponsors form a bounded garden grown outside any operator; their total backing is a fixed river. A farm can mint endless clones, but all must draw from that same river, so real endorsement splits and each alias keeps a 1/N sliver. At settlement a falcon rechecks every sponsor-to-agent edge and burns the bond behind forged or kin backing, so clones cannot sponsor themselves, and two operators who cross-back each other both forfeit.
